Instrument.name: CLPS Task Order 19D Lunar Instrumentation for Subsurface Thermal Exploration with Rapidity (LISTER)
Instrument.description: The Lunar Instrumentation for Subsurface Thermal Exploration with Rapidity (LISTER) is the first robotically deployed subsurface thermal probe that actively excavates lunar regolith and makes scientific measurements at multiple depths. It was deployed in Mare Crisium on Blue Ghost Mission 1 in March 2025, reached 1-m depth, and measured temperature and thermal conductivity of the regolith at 8 different depths.
